description: This file defines the SmsRequestParam class used for encapsulating request parameters for SMS-related operations, including filtering options like status, date range, locale, pagination, and sorting.

classes.name: SmsRequestParam
classes.description: A data class that holds SMS request parameters, annotated for automatic getter/setter generation and no-argument constructor, used in API to filter and paginate SMS messages.

methods.name: none
methods.description: The class relies on Lombok annotations (@Data, @NoArgsConstructor) for method generation; no explicit methods are defined.
